proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: My granddad's hayfield behind the house had gone to cedar and broomsedge since the eighties. Hank's crew brought it back over a week in October, and you can see the old terraces again.
reviews.name: Loretta P.

reviews.text: Our lot in Forest drops off hard toward the creek. They mulched instead of bulldozing, left the roots holding the bank, and the driveway went in without a single washout this spring.
reviews.name: Gideon A.

reviews.text: Tree of heaven had taken over the whole north side of the farm. They cut it, treated the stumps, and came back in July for the sprouts. Two years on, it hasn't returned.
reviews.name: Winifred C.

reviews.text: Hank and his son walked the property line with me and the old survey, found the iron pins, and cleared right along it. Neighbors were happy too.
reviews.name: Ellis B.

reviews.text: We lost four big poplars in the ice storm, two on the fence and one across the farm road. They had it all opened up in two days and mulched the tops where they fell.
reviews.name: Opal R.

reviews.text: Good, careful people. They reopened an old logging road on our place so we can get the truck to the back field again, and they followed the contour so it doesn't rut out.
reviews.name: Silas F.

proof.guarantee: We come back within the first growing season to cut any resprouts on ground we cleared.
